Among the 12 models, the only significant one was for the C3 or local roadways after 8:00 p.m. and for average illuminance (Table 32). In the model, average illuminance was found to be positively correlated with ND crime ratios on local roadways, indicating that higher average illuminance levels correlated with higher ND crime ratios. This is possibly due to the factor that more nighttime crimes may occur at commercial areas where there are more nighttime activities. Roadways with more commercial developments typically have higher illuminance levels due to ambient light.
